goal: Allow regtest users to generate blocks with multiple custom coinbase payout outputs
Simulate mining pool payouts and non-standard coinbases without manual block construction
Enable generateblock to automatically mine transactions from the mempool when omitted
agreement: Strong support for testing multi-recipient coinbase payouts like Ocean and Braidpool (supertestnet)
Open suggestion to split making the argument optional into a preparatory PR (maflcko)
Open suggestion to require at least one output address instead of allowing an empty list (achow101)
Past objections regarding backwards compatibility and test behavior were addressed (achow101, andrewtoth)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it fulfills a developer request to test multi-output pool payouts on regtest
It eliminates manual raw block construction for developers simulating pools like Ocean or Braidpool
The improvement is targeted at regtest development and testing rather than mainnet node operation
